detail: Verified installed Codex CLI and official hook docs (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). Bash is the hook alias for exec_command; apply_patch has command text rather than file_path. PLUGIN_ROOT is the hook root variable; plugin hooks need user trust. Local create-hook skill describes Cursor .cursor schema and is inapplicable. Use default hooks/hooks.json discovery, keeping hooks out of the legacy manifest for validator compatibility.
summary: Codex supports Twining lifecycle hooks; apply_patch inputs and Claude-only dispatch instructions need adaptation.
